creating.label: Setting up
creating.title: This Odoo is being set up
creating.text: The database and apps are being created. You will be taken in as soon as it is ready.

updating.label: Updating
updating.title: Updating this Odoo
updating.text: A new version is being applied. It will be back in a few minutes and you will be taken in.

restoring.label: Restoring
restoring.title: Restoring the data
restoring.text: The data is being restored from a backup. You will be taken in when it is done.

starting.label: Starting
starting.title: Starting…
starting.text: Odoo is starting. This usually takes less than a minute.

maintenance.label: Maintenance
maintenance.title: Scheduled maintenance
maintenance.text: The server is being updated. It will be back in a few minutes and you will be taken in.

not_responding.label: Not responding
not_responding.title: This Odoo is not responding
not_responding.text: This is usually temporary. This page keeps retrying and takes you in when it answers.

failing.label: Having a problem
failing.title: This Odoo ran into a problem
failing.text: Its team has been told. This page keeps retrying and takes you in as soon as it works again.

verifying_domain.label: Preparing the domain
verifying_domain.title: Preparing this address
verifying_domain.text: This domain is new and its certificate is being issued. This usually takes a few minutes.

stopped.label: Stopped
stopped.title: This Odoo is stopped
stopped.text: It was stopped by its administrators. If you need it, contact them.

expired.label: Expired
expired.title: This copy no longer exists
expired.text: It was a temporary test copy and was removed when it expired. Ask for a new one if you need it.

unknown.label: Page not found
unknown.title: There is no Odoo at this address
unknown.text: Check that the address is spelled correctly.

discover.label: Discover Dooservice
discover.hint: If you do not know why you landed here

projects.label: My projects
projects.hint: Check the list of your environments

help.label: Get help
help.hint: If you want to recover a deleted environment
